verdict.rationale: Daytona is sandbox infrastructure, and the evidence never shows versioning, review, or rollback for automations or workflows. Snapshots capture sandbox filesystem and memory state at a point in time. That is an adjacent environment-state feature, not version control or rollback for automation definitions, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: versioned automation definitions, a review/diff workflow for automation changes, rollback to prior automation versions, and any documentation or corroboration of these.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
